args.body: Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your website (www.dora-website.com). It's nice and simple — it clearly says it's your personal site and lists your email so people can reach you. My main feedback: it's quite sparse, so consider adding a bit about yourself (who you are, what you do/your interests) and maybe a photo or links, so visitors get a sense of you beyond the contact info. Happy to help if you want a second look at a revamp!

Feedback: it's pretty short right now, so consider adding actual blog posts (e.g. your favorite hiking trails with photos) and a way for readers to comment or contact you. Then it'll feel more like a blog people want to revisit!
